title: Pet cat tries to participate in the Christmas season by bringing home an unexpected 'present' for the family
description:
While humans are busy checking their lists, this feline decided it was high time she contributed to the family Christmas tradition.

"Our cat came in the house with a 'present' to put under the tree!" the filmer, Carl, told WooGlobe. "We let her outside to enjoy her present afterwards."

The 'gift' turned out to be an innocent creature that the cat had found roaming outside.

The kitty's gesture was as thoughtful as it was slightly chaotic.

It turns out that even our four-legged friends understand that the holidays are all about the spirit of giving.
